description.en: K9-Bench is a benchmark focused on real-world domestic dog videos, with approximately 5,000 question-answer pairs across 907 videos spanning 5 task categories. The tasks test long-form, canine-centric multimodal reasoning, including action and interaction understanding. A VLM/LLM-powered pipeline was used for data generation.

evidence.snippet: We introduce K9-Bench, a novel benchmark focused on real-world domestic dog videos, specifically targeting canine action and interaction understanding via approximately 5000 question-answer pairs across 907 videos spanning 5 distinct task categories that test long-form, canine-centric multimodal reasoning in MLLMs.

claire_radar.motivation: MLLMs have shown strong zero-shot capabilities across diverse inputs such as across images, video, audio, and text.
